priyanka: Cutting RC gcp-rc-2026-03-20-rc3 now. Artifact: gs://redwood-builds/rc3.tar.gz. Requesting signoff for a 2h change window starting 21:00 UTC. Need SRE + PM + QA ok. Rolling pin strategy: pin traffic to rc-variant then gradual shift.

deploy-bot: build #3421 succeeded — artifacts: gs://redwood-builds/rc3.tar.gz (md5: d41d8cd98). image sha: sha256:abc123def456. CI checks: unit/integration/e2e passed.

alex: Quick perf note — this RC includes KV-cache change. Validated on staging: p95 latency ~120ms, token throughput stable. Dashboard: /dashboards/rc3-latency.

maria: QA done on staging, smoke tests green. Found minor logging spam in auth path, not blocking. ✅

sre-oncall: SRE watching. Recommend 15% canary for 30m then 50% for 30m. Rollback plan: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --to-revision=42` or `redwoodctl promote --rollback-image sha256:previous`. Alerting runbook linked: /runbooks/rc-promotion-rollback.

jack: PM signoff granted. Change window approved.

priyanka: OK locking artifact: pin command: `redwoodctl pin --service inference --image sha256:abc123def456 --env prod --note "rc3 pin before promo"`. Pinned in registry and deployment config.

alex: Also adding short-circuit fallback to smaller model as safety; updated routing policy to include model-fallback on latency spike.

deploy-bot: scheduled promotion at 21:10 UTC (UTC). Will perform rolling updates across all prod pools.

priyanka: starting promotion now. Will stream deploy logs here.

deploy-bot: deploy started: rolling update across 12 pods. Parallelism=3. Logs: 
```
rolling-update: pod-1 -> image sha256:abc123def456
pod-2 -> image sha256:abc123def456
pod-3 -> image sha256:abc123def456
```

maria: seeing initial 5% traffic to rc3, no errors, traces look normal. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: metrics look OK, error rate stable, 95th latency unchanged. Keeping watch for 30m.

deploy-bot: progressing to 50% traffic after canary checks. Health checks passing.

priyanka: kicking off post-deploy validation: perf baseline, cost delta check, regression suite for top-10 prompts.

deploy-bot: promotion complete. All pods running image sha256:abc123def456. Traffic at 100%.

sre-oncall: Observability green. No anomalies in the last 20m.

priyanka: filing release note: rc3 includes KV-cache optimization, routing fallback, and small auth logging fix. Follow-up ticket for logging cleanup: RDW-2234.

jack: thanks team — great coordination. Closing change window. :party-parrot:

priyanka: closing thread, will post final notes to release-notes channel and product.
